一九七一年八月一日，清晨六点。

起床号响过没多久，操场上已经站满了人。出完早操，大家没散，按照连排班级的位置站好，整整齐齐的。天刚亮不久，东边的天空泛着鱼肚白，操场上的草叶上还挂着露水。

教导员站在队列前面，整了整军帽，声音洪亮：“今天是八一建军节，我们庆祝中国人民解放军建军四十四周年。全体都有——向右看——齐！”

队列里一阵整齐的脚步声。几百个人同时向右

正是如此，每年都有不少心怀不满或者战意澎湃的学员纷纷找到冒险王挑战。

只见，在他的身，迅速的升起一片厚重的土黄色的光芒，形成了一层最坚固的护盾。将那些肆虐的风刃，全部抵挡在了外面，无法再前进一步。

林峰他们这边朝着万兴镇而去，在省城的一处大宅子中，赵家家主赵景天和他的弟弟赵成平坐在一起，两人的神‘色’截然相反，赵成平是有些羞恼，而赵景天则是云淡风轻，甚至还略带着点儿笑意。

“天帝已经陨落了”王彪平静的说道，渀佛在讲诉一件没什么大不了的事一样。

“这鱼怎么就像我一样？”‘玉’榭气不打一处，手指一点，澹台明月“呀”的一声。那鱼顿时就蹿入水中，受了惊吓，顿时就沉入水下，再也不肯上来了。

蓝柯和侍卫一人一边，凡是接近的人都被扔了过去，所以北斗和绿绮倒是没有什么影响。

裂天金翅很强，这一点毋庸置疑，先不说那恐怖的速度增幅，十倍的差距是多么的变态，就算是那空间切割能力也是强大到逆天了，不过梁栋郁闷的是自己变鸟人了，难道不是吗？翅膀都长出来了还不是鸟人是什么？

“明月，有些麻烦。”麻星曜微微皱眉，他们这边距离门口有些距离，华青岚没有声嘶力竭的大叫，他们自然也听不清楚他们说什么，但是，感觉华青岚和秋华的目光都向着他这边看过来，他就知道有麻烦。

皓的实力这么强应该也不会差不然的话也说不出这样豪言壮志的话，米霍克对这一场战斗更加期待了。

温热的茶水被倒进杯中，如玉般的手指轻轻喷了喷茶杯，那茶水瞬间便冒起热气来，水微微翻腾，如煮沸的茶水。

王石不需要去思考问题，不需要去想宋生为什么要帮助自己，他要做的只是他本应该要做的事情，要不然宋生的箭便浪费了。留给他的时间，不是很多了，而他还有很多事情要做。

“我想最好你能够把你手中的最精锐的王牌部队，特种作战部队派出去执行这次的任务！”史迪威认真的说道。

“这个就不老墨三兄担心了！这些都是校长定下的战略方针，我只是照办就是了！”说着张烈阳端起了茶杯吹了吹茶叶喝起茶来。

赵昌会仍旧记得东家夫人跟他说过最多的一次话，就是表哥表嫂来福满楼吃饭那次，所以印象很是深刻。

“左公子！”慕云昭似乎抑制不住心里的激动般，一抹惊喜显示在面上。

华夏银行的大堂经理则一脸尴尬的笑容跟三孙子一样微弯着膝盖陪在王涛和毛伟身边说着好话，不时擦一下头上的汗水，从他那神态就可以看出他内心的紧张来。

“既然我会在这里等候着二皇子，就没想过要让自己逃脱。”左卿的神色看来并没有什么不对，这让燕逸飞心底也冒出了些许疑问。

August 1, 1971, six o'clock in the morning.

Not long after the wake-up call sounded, the playground was already full of people.After the morning exercises, everyone stayed and stood neatly according to the position of the company class.Not long after dawn, the sky in the east was glowing white, and dew was still hanging on the grass blades on the playground.

The instructor stood in front of the queue, adjusted his military cap, and said in a loud voice: "Today is Army Day. We celebrate the 44th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. Everyone - look to the right - Qi!"

There was a sound of neat footsteps in the queue.Hundreds of people turned to the right at the same time

Because of this, every year, many students who are dissatisfied or eager to fight come to Adventure King to challenge them.

I saw that a thick earth-yellow light quickly rose around his body, forming the strongest shield.All those raging wind blades were blocked outside, making it impossible to move forward one step further.

Lin Feng and the others were heading towards Wanxing Town. In a large house in the provincial capital, Zhao Jingtian, the head of the Zhao family, and his younger brother Zhao Chengping were sitting together. Their expressions were completely opposite. Zhao Chengping was a little embarrassed, while Zhao Jingtian was calm and relaxed, even with a little smile.

"The Emperor of Heaven has fallen," Wang Biao said calmly, as if he was talking about something that was no big deal.

"Why is this fish just like me?" 'Yu' Xie was not angry at all, but pointed her finger, and the bright moon in Tantai said "Ah".The fish immediately jumped into the water, was frightened, immediately sank under the water, and refused to come up again.

Lan Ke and the guards were on one side, and anyone who came close was thrown away, so Beidou and Lu Qi had no impact.

There is no doubt that the Sky-Splitting Golden Wings are very strong. Not to mention the terrifying speed increase, the ten-fold difference is so abnormal. Even the space-cutting ability is so powerful that it defies heaven. But what makes Liang Dong depressed is that he has turned into a birdman, isn't he?What is he but a birdman if he has grown wings?

"Mingyue, there's some trouble." Ma Xingyao frowned slightly. They were some distance away from the door. Hua Qinglan didn't scream at the top of his lungs. Naturally, they couldn't hear what they were saying. However, he felt that Hua Qinglan and Qiuhua were looking at him, and he knew there was trouble.

Hao's strength should not be different, otherwise he wouldn't be able to say such bold words. Mihawk was looking forward to this battle even more.

The warm tea was poured into the cup, and the jade-like fingers gently sprayed the tea cup. The tea instantly started to steam, and the water stirred slightly, like boiling tea.

Wang Shi didn't need to think about the problem or why Song Sheng wanted to help him. All he had to do was what he should have done, otherwise Song Sheng's arrow would have been wasted.There wasn't much time left for him, and he still had a lot to do.

"I think it would be best for you to send your most elite ace force, the special operations force, to carry out this mission!" Stilwell said seriously.

"Brother Mo, don't worry about this anymore! These are the strategic policies set by the principal, I just follow them!" Zhang Lieyang picked up the tea cup and blew the tea leaves to drink the tea.

Zhao Changhui still remembers the time his wife told him the most, which was when his cousin came to Fumanlou for dinner, so he was very impressed.

"Master Zuo!" Mu Yunzhao seemed to be unable to suppress the excitement in his heart, a hint of surprise appeared on his face.

The lobby manager of Hua Xia Bank had an awkward smile on his face like the third grandson. He slightly bent his knees and stayed with Wang Tao and Mao Wei, saying good things and wiping the sweat on his head from time to time. From his expression, you could see his inner nervousness.

"Since I will be waiting for the second prince here, I have never thought about letting myself escape." There seemed to be nothing wrong with Zuo Qing's expression, which made Yan Yifei have some doubts in his heart.
